thesis: The episode introduces Ellen Ellison, the chief investment officer of the University of Illinois Foundation, who rebuilt a portfolio from scratch with a small team to achieve strong returns. Her career path evolved from an initial attempt at investment banking to asset management, a shift influenced by mentorship from Bruce Greenwald at Columbia Business School that established her as a value investor.
